Glossary / Slippage
Glossary · Trading

Slippage स्लिपेज

The difference between the expected price of a trade and the price it actually fills at.

हिंदी में: स्लिपेज

ट्रेड की अपेक्षित कीमत और वास्तविक भरी गई कीमत के बीच का अंतर।

How it is used in the lessons

Thinly traded stocks have wide spreads and large slippage, which can erase any edge.

From Intraday Trading

Traders who traded more often lost more on average; brokerage, taxes and slippage alone take a large share.
